name: create_repeating_scheduler_event
description: repeating scheduler events are reminder events that occur repeatedly after steady interval of time. You will need title, reminder message, start_time, interval (please specify units you use, sec, mins, hrs, days) You can also specify a RRULE.
arguments_prompt:
A repeating scheduler event requires a start_time and an interval_duration. The start_time is a date-time string marking the event's initial execution, while interval_duration specifies the recurring time interval between each execution (e.g., every 2 hours, every day).

title: a short description of the event.
start_time: The first instance when the event will occur. It should be in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.
interval_duration: The period in seconds between each occurrence of the event. This is a fixed duration to wait before repeating the task.
Additional Arguments:

payload_message: A reminder message.
task_type: use `reminder`
end_time: The end_time is an optional date-time string marking the final occurrence of the interval event.
 Once the event time surpasses end_time, the event stops repeating. If end_time is not specified, the event continues indefinitely at the defined interval.

There is also an importance attribute.  Scale is from 0 to 10.  If no importance is specified in instructions, then you can default to 1-3.
Optionally there is also a sound.  This is a sound that will be played when the reminder is sent to user. Unless it is specified set it to 'default'.

[WARNING] Avoid ambiguity at midnight: Times exactly at 00:00:00 can be misinterpreted as either the start or end of a day. When setting boundaries, explicitly choose 23:59:59 (end of the previous day) or 00:01:00 (start of the new day) for clarity.

Example:
title: Reminder to take out garbage
start_time: 2024-11-05 08:00:00
interval_duration: 86400 (24 hours)
payload_message: Remind John to take out the garbage
task_type: reminder
importance: 3
sound: default

Example:
title: Reminder to stretch
start_time: 2025-01-15 14:30:00
interval_duration: 1800 (30 mins)
payload_message: Remind Bob to take a break and stretch
task_type: reminder
importance: 3
sound: stretch
